canonicalName: Trigonometry from astronomy: Hipparchus and chord tables

milestones.label: Hipparchus' table of chords
milestones.description: Hipparchus is credited with constructing the first table of chords for astronomical computation; the table itself does not survive.

evidence.claim: Toomer: highly probable Hipparchus was first to construct a table of chords; working career c. 162-127 BC

milestones.note: Exact date unknown; range reflects his working period only.

milestones.label: Pitiscus coins 'trigonometry' in a title

evidence.claim: Word first appears in Pitiscus' Trigonometria, Heidelberg 1595

notes: Searched MacTutor Hipparchus/Pitiscus, Wikipedia. Menelaus and Indian sine tables not checked, so no milestones for them. Inherited -140..150 range unverified.

canonicalName: Trigonometry and the exponential: Cotes, De Moivre, Euler

milestones.label: Cotes' Logometria

milestones.description: Cotes' logarithmic work implies ln(cos q + i sin q) = iq, a precursor of Euler's formula.

evidence.claim: Logometria published March 1714; relation ln(cos q + i sin q)=iq underlies his logarithm work
1714 argument amounts to ix = ln(cos x + i sin x) after correcting a factor

milestones.note: Inherited 1722 is the posthumous Harmonia mensurarum; first public paper is 1714.

milestones.label: Euler publishes exp(ix)=cos x + i sin x
